It is built by a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories. Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy. An audit over 3{,}000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, reuse their own history less even when it is fully in the workspace, and leave duplicated logic in 50.8\% of task chains by turn~5---all while pass rates barely move. Such deficiencies are invisible to pass rates, underscoring the need to evaluate code generation beyond functional correctness.
articles.titleCn: 编码代理是重用现有代码还是重新发明轮子？
articles.abstractCn: 代码代理正越来越多地部署用于真实代码库的迭代开发，然而现有的评估几乎无法回答一个基本问题：\emph{代码代理是重用现有代码还是重新发明轮子？}这个问题很重要：每一次重复的实现都是两次应用修复，而代理生成代码的速度远快于人能审核的速度，因此冗余会无监督地累积。为此，我们提出了\textbf{RepoReuse}，一个用于审核真实代码库中代码重用的多轮基准，其中需求逐轮揭示，工作空间随轮次累积。它由一个全自动流程构建，结合基于抽象语法树的依赖图、引导证据收集和执行验证的任务合成，并能轻松扩展到新的代码库。除了通过率，我们还测量了重用率以及召回率和跨轮次结构冗余。超过3{,}000轮的审核显示，代理逐渐停止探索相关代码库代码，即使其历史完全在工作空间中，也减少重用自身历史，并在第5轮时在50.8%的任务链中留下重复逻辑——而通过率几乎未变。这些缺陷对通过率来说不可见，突显了需要超越功能正确性来评估代码生成的必要性。

articles.title: Jailbreaks for Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification in Large Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model's effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U's improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 times more LRM-dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.
articles.titleCn: 针对大型推理模型中的黑盒不确定性量化进行越狱
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在复杂推理方面表现出色，但通过强化学习进行的对齐往往会导致系统性过度自信。在生产环境中，由于可能无法获取logits，鲁棒的黑盒不确定性量化（UQ）对于可信度和安全性至关重要。针对LRMs的问答任务，我们表明现有的黑盒方法，如基于释义的自我一致性以及置信度语言化，与简单的重复采样相比几乎没有或没有改进，这表明对齐抑制了有用的输出变异性。我们引入了提示级松弛算子，通过近似使用更强的KL正则化参数获得的最优策略的效果，从而扩展模型的有效输出分布，使其更接近参考模型。理论上，我们证明了松弛提高了校准度。我们提出了“不确定性逃脱”（Jailbreak for Uncertainty, J4U），这是一种基于逃脱技巧的UQ方法，经验上复现了我们松弛理论预测的行为特征。在3个数据集和4个LRMs上（包括一个闭源生产模型），J4U相较于重复采样的改进在高达6倍的LRM-数据集度量设置中实现了统计显著性，平均ECE降低幅度高达5倍。这些结果为黑盒LRM部署中的UQ提供了一种实用工具。

articles.title: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects genuine contextual reasoning or reliance on facts memorized in their parameters. We investigate this by distinguishing two possibilities: a broad \textit{memorization bias}, where familiar content improves reasoning performance, and the \textit{Strong Parametric Shortcut Hypothesis}, where models skip reasoning entirely and recall stored answers. To test these effects, we introduce \textbf{MemoReason}, a human-curated benchmark that pairs factual reasoning tasks with structurally identical \fictitiousterm{} versions where real entities like people, companies, or dates are systematically replaced by \fictitiousterm{} ones of the same type. This \scorerevision{preserves task structure and specified reasoning operations} while varying the familiarity of the context, allowing controlled measurement of how the parametric memory affects reasoning. \revision{Our evaluation of recent LLMs reveals consistent and statistically significant performance drops of up to 15.7\% in the fictitious setting, demonstrating a clear memorization bias.} However, a targeted analysis of \revision{questions failed in the fictitious setting} shows that models rarely respond with the corresponding factual answer, indicating that direct parametric shortcuts are not the dominant failure mode. These findings suggest that parametric memory influences reasoning through mechanisms more complex than simple factual recall. \textbf{MemoReason} provides a controlled framework for studying these mechanisms and for extending paired factual-fictitious{} evaluation to broader reasoning settings.
articles.titleCn: 备忘原因：评估参数化记忆对大型语言模型中上下文推理的影响
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理基准测试中表现优异，但其是否真正具备上下文推理能力，还是仅仅依赖于参数中记忆的事实，目前尚不明确。我们通过区分两种可能性来研究这一问题：一是广泛的“记忆偏差”，即熟悉内容会提升推理性能；二是“强参数捷径假说”，即模型完全跳过推理，直接回忆存储的答案。为了检验这些效应，我们引入了由人类精心策划的基准测试MemoReason，该测试将事实推理任务与结构上完全相同的虚构版本配对，其中真实实体（如人物、公司或日期）被同类型的虚构实体系统性地替换。这种设计既保留了任务结构和指定的推理操作，又改变了上下文的熟悉度，从而允许对参数记忆如何影响推理进行受控测量。我们的评估结果显示，在虚构环境中，近期LLMs的表现始终存在显著且统计上显著的下降，降幅高达15.7%，这表明存在明显的记忆偏差。然而，对在虚构环境中失败的提问进行针对性分析表明，模型很少给出相应的事实性答案，这表明直接的参数捷径并非主要的失效模式。这些发现表明，参数记忆通过比简单事实回忆更复杂的机制影响推理。MemoReason提供了一个受控框架，用于研究这些机制，并将事实-虚构配对评估扩展到更广泛的推理环境中。

articles.title: Epistemic Policy Divergence in Multi-Turn LLM Contamination: A Protocol-Gradient Investigation
articles.abstract: Large language models process conversation history as unverified context: false premises injected into prior turns can be adopted as fact, a failure mode we term session-level contamination. We introduce five contamination protocols arranged along a source-authority gradient, isolating distinct failure mechanisms while holding the false premise constant, and evaluate GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite, and GLM-4.5-Air across ten knowledge domains at temperature zero (22,500 turns), using a dual-track automated judge validated against a human gold standard (Cohen's \k{appa} = 0.901). GPT-5.4 Mini showed zero adoptions across all 500 sessions, a content-independent policy at the session level; token-level probing shows the underlying margin, while large, is finite. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite followed a steep authority gradient: 0.1% adoption for self-attributed falsehoods, 23.5% for user-cited sources, 68.2% for system-injected authority, and 94.0% under instruction override. GLM-4.5-Air showed a shallower gradient (15.8% vs 84.2%), a 68-percentage-point dissociation confirming that authority deference and instruction compliance are distinct mechanisms within one architecture. Recovery also diverged: GLM recovered in 94.5% of affected sessions, whereas 26.1% of affected Gemini sessions never did, rising to 40.0% under instruction override. Conversation history is an untrusted attack surface requiring provenance-aware system design; the complete framework is released as an open-source benchmark.
articles.comment: 9 figures, 19 tables. Benchmark, code, and protocol definitions: https://github.com/fahrellgiovanny/epistemic-policy-divergence
articles.titleCn: 多轮LLM污染中的认知策略分歧：基于协议梯度的研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型将对话历史作为未经验证的上下文处理：先前回合中注入的错误前提可能被当作事实采纳，我们称这种现象为会话级污染。我们引入了五种污染协议，这些协议沿着来源权威梯度排列，在保持错误前提不变的情况下隔离不同的失效机制，并评估了GPT-5.4 Mini、Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite和GLM-4.5-Air在十个知识领域中的表现（温度设为零，共22,500回合），使用经过人类黄金标准验证的双轨自动裁判（Cohen's \k{appa} = 0.901）。GPT-5.4 Mini在所有500个会话中均未出现采纳现象，显示出会话层面的内容无关策略；而token级探测显示，尽管基础容限较大，但仍是有限的。Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite遵循陡峭的权威梯度：自我归因的错误被采纳率为0.1%，用户引用的来源为23.5%，系统注入的权威为68.2%，在指令覆盖下为94.0%。GLM-4.5-Air显示出较平缓的梯度（15.8% vs 84.2%），68个百分点的分离度证实了在单一架构中，权威顺从和指令合规是不同的机制。恢复过程也出现分化：GLM在受影响会话的94.5%中恢复，而Gemini受影响会话中有26.1%从未恢复，在指令覆盖下升至40.0%。对话历史是一个不受信任的攻击面，需要具备来源意识的系统设计；完整的框架已作为开源基准发布。

articles.title: Decide, Don't Generate: Competitive Dimensional ABSA with Jev's Typed Decisions
articles.abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) has largely turned to text generation. We show that competitive dimensional ABSA does not need it. Using Jev, a frozen model that answers typed questions with rubric scores, label probabilities, and yes/no judgments, we decompose all three tasks of SemEval-2026 Task III Track A into such decisions and align them with the annotation scheme through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, with no text generation and no backbone tuning. On valence-arousal regression over ten corpora in six languages, the system reaches 1.0645 RMSE, the lowest aggregate error of any participating system. On triplet and quadruplet extraction, it reaches 52.09 and 44.06 continuous F1, above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines. Analyses and ablations show where the accuracy comes from: supervised calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, exact valence-arousal would add only 4.5 F1 to extraction, and the learned combination of span-boundary evidence, not any single signal, carries the extraction systems.
articles.titleCn: 决定，而非生成：基于杰夫类型决策的竞争性维度ABSA
articles.abstractCn: 基于方面的情感分析（ABSA）已广泛转向文本生成。我们证明，竞争性维度ABS A无需此方法。使用Jev，一个能够用评分标准、标签概率和是/否判断来回答类型问题的冻结模型，我们将SemEval-2026任务III A的所有三个任务分解为这些决策，并通过在CPU上拟合的488个系数与标注方案对齐，无需文本生成和主干网络调优。在六种语言的十个语料库上的效价-唤醒回归任务中，该系统达到1.0645 RMSE，是所有参与系统中误差最低的。在三元组和四元组提取任务中，它达到52.09和44.06的连续F1，高于微调后的Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B基线。分析和消融实验表明了准确性的来源：监督校准将原始回归误差大致减半，精确的效价-唤醒仅对提取任务增加4.5 F1，而提取系统所依赖的是跨边界证据的组合学习，而非任何单一信号。

articles.title: EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.
articles.titleCn: EvoIn：连接进化和内化，用于智能体微调
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究探索了通过联合进化代理的 harness 和模型来改进代理，但通常采用一种“大杂烩”方法，将新工具、新决策程序和模型对进化 harness 的适应捆绑在单一代理改进概念下。在本文中，我们研究了代理如何改进其决策程序。具体而言，我们提出了 EvoIn，一个连接进化与内化的代理微调框架。EvoIn 首先分析代理执行轨迹，通过在 harness 中临时实例化新决策程序来进化和验证它们。经过验证的程序指导代理生成改进的推理轨迹。然后，将这些轨迹重写为自包含的推理轨迹，移除对 harness 指令的显式引用，同时将诱导的决策逻辑表达为模型的推理。最后，EvoIn 在重写的轨迹上微调模型，内化这些程序，使得改进的决策在推理时无需进化 harness 即可持续存在。我们在多样化的基准测试上评估了 EvoIn，发现它始终能使代理学习更强的决策程序，在领域内将通过率提高了 10.9 分，领域外提高了 9.2 分。结果进一步表明，内化的决策程序可以泛化到未见过的任务。案例研究表明，代理可以学会在解决任务之前决定如何解决它，例如通过检查文档长度来选择是通读还是搜索。EvoIn 也具有广泛的适用性，在另一个模型家族上显示出持续改进。

articles.title: Measuring Collapse and Correction in Homogeneous-Panel LLM Debate
articles.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) debate is often evaluated by whether final answers improve, but movement is not necessarily improvement: the same discussion can rescue an initially wrong majority or destroy an initially correct one. Standard final-accuracy evaluations conflate these opposing mechanisms. We introduce an auditable protocol for homogeneous debate on multiple-choice questions (MCQs) that records each run as a transition ledger over collapse, correction, onset, and signed intervention utility. On 6,925 MMLU-Pro debates, the protocol identifies 253 collapses and a parallel correction ledger that changes how interventions should be judged. Replay experiments reveal the central tradeoff: a leave-one-model-out probe-gated freeze prevents 29 collapses but loses 108 corrections under equal weights, so collapse prevention alone can recommend the wrong policy. A compact pre-debate 8-probe screen is a triage signal: its unadjusted family-level association with conditional-collapse risk is high (G=7, Spearman rho=0.893, exact two-sided p=0.0123), but initial-majority accuracy is a close comparator (rho=0.821; family partial rho=0.767, p=0.0877), so we do not treat it as calibrated or capability-adjusted prediction. Round-level traces localize many collapses to the first debate round, where early disagreement can precede both harmful cascades and useful recovery. We release replayable schemas, coders, audits, cost cards, and zero-API rebuild scripts so future model-scaffold rows can be compared under the same denominators and signed utility ledger.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). Project page: https://lixin.ai/DebateLedger. Code: https://github.com/LiXin97/DebateLedger
articles.titleCn: 测量同质面板LLM辩论中的崩溃与纠正
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）辩论通常通过最终答案是否改进来评估，但运动不一定是改进：同样的讨论可能挽救最初错误的多数，也可能摧毁最初正确的多数。标准的最终准确率评估混淆了这些相反的机制。我们引入了一个用于多项选择题（MCQ）同质辩论的可审计协议，该协议将每次运行记录为关于崩溃、纠正、发生和有符号干预效用的转换账本。在6925场MMLU-Pro辩论中，该协议识别出253次崩溃，并有一个平行的纠正账本，改变了干预应该如何被评判的方式。重放实验揭示了核心权衡：留出一个模型不参与的探测门冻结阻止了29次崩溃，但在同等权重下损失了108次纠正，因此仅靠防止崩溃可能推荐错误策略。一个紧凑的辩论前8探测器筛选是一个分诊信号：其与条件性崩溃风险的未调整家族级关联性很高（G=7，Spearman rho=0.893，精确双尾p=0.0123），但初始多数准确率是一个接近的比较对象（rho=0.821；家族部分rho=0.767，p=0.0877），因此我们不将其视为校准或能力调整的预测。回合级追踪将许多崩溃定位到第一轮辩论中，早期分歧可能先于有害级联和有用恢复发生。我们发布了可重放的架构、编码器、审计、成本卡和零-API重建脚本，以便未来的模型框架行可以在相同的分母和有符号效用账本下进行比较。

articles.title: When Words Speak Louder than Images: Towards Understanding Language Bias in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Despite substantial progress across downstream applications, vision-language models (VLMs) remain susceptible to language bias, often prioritizing linguistic cues over visual evidence and consequently producing incorrect predictions. Prior studies have proposed various approaches to understanding and mitigating language bias in VLMs, yet their findings often conflict due to the difficulty of tracing how language bias propagates within black-box VLMs. Building on the word completion task, we trace how language bias propagates through VLM inference by (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decomposes the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages to trace the propagation of language bias; and (2) examining how two key factors underlying language bias, i.e., linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage, evolve across these stages and ultimately give rise to incorrect predictions. The linguistic prior captures the strength of statistical bias induced by the language model component of a VLM and represents the origin of language bias, whereas cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which linguistic cues cover the visual content. By decomposing inference into four stages and characterizing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage across these stages, we propose a systematic framework for tracing the propagation of language bias throughout the inference process; and uncover the underlying mechanism of language bias by revealing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage.
articles.titleCn: 当言语胜于图像：迈向理解视觉语言模型中的语言偏见
articles.abstractCn: 尽管下游应用取得了显著进展，视觉语言模型（VLMs）仍然容易受到语言偏差的影响，常常优先考虑语言线索而忽视视觉证据，从而产生错误的预测。先前研究提出了多种理解和减轻VLM中语言偏差的方法，但由于难以追踪语言偏差在黑盒VLM内部的传播方式，其研究结果往往相互矛盾。基于词补全任务，我们通过（1）提出一个诊断框架，将推理过程分解为四个既独立又相互依赖的阶段，以追踪语言偏差的传播；（2）考察语言偏差背后的两个关键因素，即语言先验和跨模态覆盖度，在这些阶段中的演变过程以及最终如何导致错误预测。语言先验捕捉了VLM语言模型组件所诱导的统计偏差的强度，代表了语言偏差的来源，而跨模态覆盖度则衡量了语言线索覆盖视觉内容的程度。通过将推理分解为四个阶段，并描述这些阶段中语言先验和跨模态覆盖度之间的相互作用，我们提出了一个系统框架，用于追踪语言偏差在整个推理过程中的传播；并通过揭示语言先验和跨模态覆盖度之间的相互作用，揭示了语言偏差的潜在机制。

articles.title: Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Personalization
articles.abstract: LLM personalization aims to generate responses aligned with individual users' preferences and needs. User-specific rubrics make these expectations explicit, providing direct supervision on what a satisfactory answer should cover. Existing rubric-guided approaches, however, exploit such guidance only at a coarse granularity, either by using rubrics to supervise the prediction of relevant aspects for subsequent generation or by reducing aspect coverage to a single response-level reward for reinforcement learning. This leaves a gap between specifying what a personalized answer should contain and teaching the model how to generate it. To bridge this gap, we propose GRASP, a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM personalization that turns user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained, token-level supervision. Specifically, GRASP pairs a rubric-free student with a rubric-informed teacher that additionally receives the target user-specific rubrics. By aligning their next-token distributions along on-policy trajectories generated by the student, GRASP transfers the teacher's rubric-conditioned guidance into the student, translating user-specific semantic requirements into dense token-level supervision. Since rubric-informed teachers can still produce inadequate supervision, we further introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which retains only instances where the teacher sufficiently covers the target aspects, improving both supervision quality and training efficiency. Experiments on the LaMP-QA benchmark for personalized question answering demonstrate that GRASP achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple backbones, supporting the effectiveness of rubric-guided token-level supervision for personalization. To ensure reproducibility, our code is available at https://github.com/SnowCharmQ/GRASP.
articles.titleCn: 基于评估标准的在线策略自蒸馏技术用于大型语言模型个性化
articles.abstractCn: LLM个性化旨在生成与个体用户偏好和需求相符的响应。用户特定的评分标准使这些期望明确化，为令人满意的答案应涵盖的内容提供直接指导。然而，现有的评分标准引导方法仅以粗粒度的方式利用此类指导，要么通过使用评分标准来监督后续生成的相关方面预测，要么通过将方面覆盖范围简化为强化学习的单一响应级奖励。这留下了在指定个性化答案应包含的内容和教导模型如何生成它之间的差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了GRASP，这是一个用于LLM个性化的评分标准感知在线策略自蒸馏框架，将用户特定的评分标准方面转化为细粒度、标记级的监督。具体而言，GRASP将一个无评分标准的学徒与一个额外的接收目标用户特定评分标准的评分标准知情教师配对。通过沿着由学徒生成的在线策略轨迹对其下一个标记分布进行对齐，GRASP将教师的评分条件指导转移给学徒，将用户特定的语义要求转化为密集的标记级监督。由于评分标准知情教师仍然可能产生不足的监督，我们进一步引入基于评分标准的教师验证（RTV），仅保留教师充分涵盖目标方面的实例，从而提高监督质量和训练效率。在个性化问答的LaMP-QA基准上的实验表明，GRASP在多个主干网络中均实现了最先进性能，支持了评分标准引导的标记级监督在个性化中的有效性。为确保可复现性，我们的代码可在https://github.com/SnowCharmQ/GRASP获取。

articles.title: SCBO: Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering for LLM-Based Social Surveys
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to simulate survey respondents using demographic profiles and observed reference responses. However, the conventional approach of predicting one question per prompt repeatedly encodes the same context, limits each target to a narrow set of reference responses, and prevents later predictions from using information in earlier answers. Predicting multiple questions in one prompt can reduce these costs, share a broader pool of references, and let later predictions build on earlier ones. This requires forming coherent batches, selecting shared references, and ordering questions and references effectively. We propose Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering (SCBO), a training-free framework that addresses these challenges. SCBO first uses an LLM to extract compact semantic representations from survey items and filter out template noise. It then groups related questions into batches and builds a shared reference bank using target-specific retrieval and centroid-based completion. Finally, it orders target questions from easy to hard and arranges references according to their semantic alignment with those questions. Experiments on four large-scale survey datasets and four LLMs show that SCBO substantially reduces token consumption and inference time while generally improving prediction accuracy over a non-batched baseline. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCBO-41D8.
articles.titleCn: SCBO：面向基于LLM的社会调查的语义连贯批处理与排序
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了一种基于人口统计特征和观察到的参考回答来模拟调查受访者的可扩展方法。然而，传统的每次预测一个问题的方法会反复编码相同的内容，将每个目标限制在狭窄的参考回答集中，并阻止后续预测使用早期答案中的信息。在一个提示中预测多个问题可以减少这些成本，共享更广泛的参考池，并允许后续预测建立在早期回答之上。这需要形成连贯的批次，选择共享参考，并有效排序问题和参考。我们提出了语义连贯批次和排序（SCBO）方法，这是一个无需训练的框架，用于解决这些挑战。SCBO首先使用LLM从调查项目中提取紧凑的语义表示并过滤掉模板噪音。然后，它将相关问题分组为批次，并使用目标特定检索和基于质心的补全构建共享参考库。最后，它从易到难排序目标问题，并根据参考与这些问题的语义一致性来排列参考。在四个大规模调查数据集和四个LLM上的实验表明，SCBO显著减少了token消耗和推理时间，同时通常提高了相对于非批次基线的预测准确性。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCBO-41D8获取。

articles.title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
articles.abstract: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.
articles.titleCn: SignFLIP：一种通过大规模分阶段对齐实现手语翻译与生成的统一模型
articles.abstractCn: 手语翻译与生成共享文本与手语表示之间双向对齐的目标。然而，现有方法要么将它们视为孤立的任务，要么仅在有限数据集上进行验证，限制了模态间有效建模。在本文中，我们提出了SignFLIP，一个以大型语言模型为中心的统一翻译与生成框架。为了实现文本与手语之间的双向映射，SignFLIP采用对称架构，并结合基于大规模数据的多阶段训练策略。共享的手语-文本表示逐步得到优化：预对齐促进了后续的跨语言翻译（SLT），而SLT适应的表示进一步有利于手语生成（SLG）。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，与特定任务的模型相比，SignFLIP在翻译和生成任务上均表现出具有竞争力的性能，并且在手语识别方面具有很强的可迁移性。

articles.title: TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs
articles.abstract: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.
articles.titleCn: TANGO：在标记对中嵌入水印的掩码扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散语言模型并行且无固定顺序地填充掩码位置。大多数实用的文本水印假设从左到右生成。它们将每个标记与它之前的标记关联，而在扩散模型中，这些标记可能仍然是掩码的。固定的绿色列表无需此类上下文，但它会使相同的标记在每个位置都更受欢迎，因此这些标记在带水印的文本中出现的频率更高。一个攻击者通过比较带水印和不带水印文本中的标记频率，可以恢复该列表并伪造提供者自己的检测器可以接受的文本。我们提出了TANGO，一种用于掩码扩散语言模型的水印，它将每个新标记与附近已解密的标记关联。一个密钥将词汇表分成颜色类别，TANGO会根据密钥和附近标记的颜色，使新标记倾向于某个颜色。因此，水印嵌入在标记对中。由于受欢迎的颜色从位置到位置都在变化，标记频率与未带水印文本的频率比固定绿色列表下的频率更接近。检测只需要文本和密钥，并且不假设任何解密顺序。在两个掩码扩散模型上，TANGO检测到几乎所有未编辑的带水印文本和大多数已编辑的文本，而伪造固定绿色列表的频率攻击无法对抗它。

articles.title: Understanding On-Policy Distillation: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective via Sparse Crosscoders
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely adopted post-training technique for LLM reasoning. It is commonly believed to transfer knowledge from a stronger teacher, yet what OPD actually distills into the student's internal representations remains unclear. We study this question with sparse crosscoders, which learn one feature dictionary shared by the student before and after OPD and the teacher. Standard crosscoder analyses, however, identify model-specific features but cannot tell how a model's use of its features changes, since all models are encoded into one set of feature activations. We therefore propose the swap readout, which reads each student checkpoint's feature activations on its own, measuring how training changes the student's use of each feature, even for checkpoints unseen by the crosscoder. Across three OPD settings, we find that OPD neither creates features nor passes on the teacher's own, and leaves the firing rates of over 98% of the student's frequently used features within 20%. We further examine the SFT warm-up on the teacher's rollouts that commonly precedes OPD and makes it more effective. Rather than adding features, the warm-up reweights the shared ones in two ways. First, it already raises and lowers many of the features that OPD later raises and lowers, doing part of OPD's work in advance. Second, it changes features that OPD alone would not, notably those for conversation format, reasoning style, and mathematical notation, and these changes persist through OPD. Imposing this reweighting on a directly distilled student's features, without changing its weights, brings its accuracy close to that of the warmed-up student, whereas the same change on shuffled features does not. Together, these findings suggest that OPD reweights existing features rather than acquiring new ones: the student learns from the teacher how to use the features they already share.
articles.titleCn: 基于稀疏交叉编码器的机制可解释视角理解在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 离线策略蒸馏（OPD）是广泛应用于大语言模型推理的后训练技术。人们普遍认为它能够将知识从更强的教师模型迁移到学生模型，但OPD实际蒸馏到学生内部表征中的具体内容尚不明确。我们通过稀疏交叉编码器研究这一问题，该编码器学习一个学生模型在OPD前后以及教师模型共享的特征字典。然而，标准的交叉编码器分析虽然能识别模型特定的特征，却无法揭示模型如何使用其特征的变化，因为所有模型都被编码为一组特征激活。因此，我们提出了交换读取方法，该方法读取每个学生检查点的特征激活，测量训练如何改变学生对每个特征的使用情况，即使这些检查点未被交叉编码器看到。在三种OPD设置下，我们发现OPD既不创建新特征，也不传递教师模型自身的特征，并且将超过98%的学生常用特征的激活率保持在20%以内。我们进一步考察了通常在OPD之前、使其更有效的教师模型推理的SFT预热过程。预热过程并非增加特征，而是通过两种方式重新加权共享特征。首先，它已经提高了和降低了OPD后来会提高和降低的许多特征，提前完成了部分OPD的工作。其次，它改变了OPD单独无法改变的某些特征，特别是对话格式、推理风格和数学符号相关的特征，这些变化会持续到OPD过程中。将这种重新加权直接应用于直接蒸馏的学生特征，而不改变其权重，可以将该学生的准确率提升至预热学生模型的水平，而相同的变化在打乱的特征上则无效。综合这些发现表明，OPD重新加权现有特征而非获取新特征：学生模型通过教师模型学习如何使用它们已经共享的特征。

articles.title: From Normative Frameworks to Alignment Data: Constructing and Evaluating SFT and Preference Data
articles.abstract: Aligning language models with a specified normative framework requires translating abstract principles into concrete examples and preference signals from which models can learn. We present an expert-driven methodology for constructing such alignment data and apply it to a normative framework grounded in Islamic ethical, theological, and jurisprudential traditions. Over approximately one year, seven domain experts systematically probed language models to identify alignment deficiencies, curated desired responses, and constructed preference pairs from model outputs and expert judgments. The resulting Arabic-English datasets contain approximately 2.8K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples and 5.4K preference pairs spanning a broad range of normative domains. We evaluate the datasets through controlled post-training experiments comparing a Baseline model with models incorporating the curated SFT data alone and both the SFT and preference data. In blind expert evaluation on 150 separately constructed prompts, the model trained with the curated SFT data was preferred over the Baseline in 51.3% of assessor judgments, compared with 14.4% in the opposite direction (p < .001 at the prompt level). Adding the preference data resulted in a smaller difference, with the model trained with both datasets preferred over the SFT model in 28.0% of judgments versus 20.9% in the opposite direction; this difference was not statistically significant at the prompt level (p = .166). Standard Arabic and English benchmarks show no broad degradation in general-purpose capabilities. These results demonstrate how expert-defined normative principles can be systematically operationalized into alignment data and evaluated through controlled model training.
articles.titleCn: 从规范框架到对齐数据：构建与评估SFT和偏好数据
articles.abstractCn: 将语言模型与特定的规范性框架进行对齐需要将抽象原则转化为具体的示例和偏好信号，以便模型能够从中学习。我们提出了一种专家主导的方法来构建此类对齐数据，并将其应用于一个基于伊斯兰伦理、神学和法学传统的规范性框架。在约一年的时间内，七位领域专家系统地探究语言模型，以识别对齐缺陷，筛选期望响应，并从模型输出和专家判断中构建偏好对。由此产生的阿拉伯语-英语数据集包含约2.8K个监督微调（SFT）示例和5.4K个偏好对，涵盖了广泛的规范性领域。我们通过受控的后续训练实验评估这些数据集，比较了基线模型、仅包含筛选SFT数据的模型以及同时包含SFT和偏好数据的模型。在针对150个单独构建的提示进行的盲法专家评估中，使用筛选SFT数据训练的模型在51.3%的评估者判断中优于基线模型，而相反方向的判断比例为14.4%（在提示层面，p < .001）。添加偏好数据后，差异较小，同时使用两个数据集训练的模型在28.0%的判断中优于SFT模型，而相反方向的判断比例为20.9%；这一差异在提示层面不具有统计学意义（p = .166）。标准阿拉伯语和英语基准测试显示，通用能力没有明显退化。这些结果表明，专家定义的规范性原则可以系统地转化为对齐数据，并通过受控模型训练进行评估。

articles.title: 5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding
articles.abstract: Transforming raw data into queryable knowledge requires both early extraction of reusable information and explicit types, relations, and applicability conditions for particular tasks. If indexing selects content too early around a single business schema, later tasks may be unable to use information that was omitted. If the index retains only open-ended text, however, rule-based reasoning lacks checkable premises. We propose 5W1H+Which, a semantic indexing design that separates content extraction from ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize source-grounded content units; Which points to versioned ontology elements and records mapping relations, scope, and validation status. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles are not merely retrieval labels: together, they constrain the contexts in which facts, bindings, and rules apply. Unbound content remains searchable, while bound content enters a formal reasoning path only after premise checks. The method further distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and uses dependency records to support binding revalidation and the maintenance of derived conclusions. A worked example of migration from an on-premises server to a cloud environment illustrates the different treatment of world-state changes, ontology-version changes, and changes in rule applicability. We formulate three groups of falsifiable hypotheses concerning cross-task evidence coverage, control of contextual misuse, and incremental update cost. The planned evaluation includes a strong typed fact-graph baseline with the same evidence, temporal information, and budget, to test whether benefits arise from 5W1H organization, deferred binding, or additional information and engineering effort. The contribution is a testable indexing mechanism, not a claim to a new universal ontology or a demonstrated performance advantage.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Preprint of a proposed indexing method with falsifiable hypotheses; not empirically validated
articles.titleCn: 5W1H+Which：基于渐进式本体绑定的上下文有效语义索引
articles.abstractCn: 将原始数据转化为可查询的知识，需要早期提取可复用信息，并为特定任务明确类型、关系和应用条件。如果索引过早围绕单一业务模式选择内容，后续任务可能无法使用被遗漏的信息。然而，如果索引仅保留开放式文本，基于规则的推理则缺乏可验证的前提。我们提出了5W1H+Which语义索引设计，将内容提取与本体绑定分离。5W1H问题组织基于来源的内容单元；Which指向版本化的本体元素，并记录映射关系、范围和验证状态。时间、地点、系统环境和参与者角色不仅是检索标签：它们共同约束了事实、绑定和规则适用的上下文。未绑定内容保持可搜索状态，而绑定内容需经前提检查后才能进入正式推理路径。该方法进一步区分业务有效时间、系统知识时间和操作痕迹，并使用依赖记录支持绑定重新验证和导出结论的维护。一个从本地服务器迁移到云环境的实例说明了世界状态变化、本体版本变化和规则适用性变化的差异化处理。我们提出了关于跨任务证据覆盖、上下文误用控制和增量更新成本的三组可证伪假设。计划中的评估将包含一个强类型事实图谱基线，具有相同的证据、时间信息和预算，以测试收益是否源于5W1H组织、延迟绑定或额外信息和工程努力。这项贡献是一个可测试的索引机制，而非对新型通用本体的主张或已证明的性能优势。

articles.title: A mechanistic study of language model introspection
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can sometimes report perturbations to their internal activations---even when the input provides no evidence that an intervention occurred. How do models detect and localize such internal changes? We study this question using a controlled task that keeps the input text fixed. We either inject a concept vector into the hidden state at one of ten token positions or apply no intervention. The model is asked to identify the perturbed position or report that no intervention occurred. Across three model families, we identify two small groups of attention heads with distinct roles in introspective reporting. Middle-layer gate heads influence whether the model reports a change, while router heads in a later layer help select the position to report. Interventions on gate heads can suppress position reports even when router heads supply location information. We further examine why reporting accuracy varies across concepts. Concept vectors that are localized more accurately produce stronger attention-score and output responses in gate heads, which is associated with better alignment of the induced key and value changes in their QK and OV computations. Together, these findings identify attention-head mechanisms supporting introspective detection and localization.
articles.titleCn: 一种语言模型内省的机理研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）有时会报告其内部激活的扰动——即使输入没有提供干预发生的证据。模型如何检测和定位此类内部变化？我们通过一个保持输入文本固定的受控任务来研究这个问题。我们在十个标记位置之一向隐藏状态注入概念向量，或应用无干预。模型被要求识别受扰动位置或报告未发生干预。在三个模型系列中，我们识别出两个具有不同introspective报告角色的注意力头组。中间层门控头影响模型是否报告变化，而较晚层中的路由头帮助选择报告的位置。对门控头的干预即使在路由头提供位置信息时也能抑制位置报告。我们进一步考察了报告准确率为何在不同概念间存在差异。定位更准确的概念向量在门控头中产生更强的注意力分数和输出响应，这与其QK和OV计算中诱导的键和值变化更好的对齐有关。这些发现共同揭示了支持introspective检测和定位的注意力头机制。

articles.title: When Confidence Rises Too Early: Detecting Shortcut Reasoning via Premature Answer Commitment
articles.abstract: The reasoning trajectory of a Large Language Model (LLM) is often treated as a verbalized description of its internal reasoning. However, such trajectories can be unfaithful: a model may rely on shortcuts to reach an answer and then post-rationalize the decision with a seemingly coherent chain of thought. Detecting this shortcut reasoning is challenging because existing monitors and verifiers mainly inspect textual traces or final outcomes, rather than how the model's belief in its answer develops during generation. We introduce ConfLens, a framework that tracks the evolution of confidence in the final answer throughout reasoning. Across three shortcut reasoning settings, we observe a common pattern of premature confidence, where shortcut samples become highly confident in the final answer at early reasoning stages. Existing confidence estimation methods, however, show limited generalizability, reliability, or efficiency for detecting this behavior. We therefore propose the Distributional Answer Commitment Score (DACS), a distributional confidence estimator that measures the entropy of the model's probability distribution over answer commitment at each reasoning step. DACS captures how concentrated the model's answer belief is without requiring ground-truth answers or task-specific verifiers. We further convert ConfLens detection results into interpretable signals for reward models to reduce their preference for shortcut reasoning. Experiments on mathematical and code reasoning tasks show that ConfLens with DACS improves shortcut reasoning detection by over 4.3% F1 compared with strong baselines and reduces the mismatch between faithfulness and correctness in reward model preferences.
articles.titleCn: 当自信过早升起：通过过早回答承诺检测捷径推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的推理轨迹通常被视为其内部推理的口头描述。然而，这种轨迹可能是不忠实的：模型可能依赖捷径来得出答案，然后用看似连贯的思维链条事后合理化这一决策。检测这种捷径推理是具有挑战性的，因为现有的监控器和验证器主要检查文本痕迹或最终结果，而不是模型在生成过程中对其答案的信念是如何发展的。我们引入了ConfLens，一个跟踪推理过程中最终答案置信度演变的框架。在三个捷径推理设置中，我们观察到一种过早置信的常见模式，即捷径样本在推理早期阶段就变得对最终答案高度自信。然而，现有的置信度估计方法在检测这种行为方面显示出有限的泛化能力、可靠性或效率。因此，我们提出了分布式答案承诺分数（DACS），这是一种分布式置信度估计器，它测量模型在每个推理步骤中答案承诺的概率分布的熵。DACS捕捉了模型答案信念的集中程度，而无需真实答案或特定任务的验证器。我们进一步将ConfLens检测结果转换为可解释的信号，以减少奖励模型对捷径推理的偏好。在数学和代码推理任务上的实验表明，与强基线相比，带有DACS的ConfLens将捷径推理检测的F1分数提高了4.3%以上，并减少了奖励模型偏好中忠实性与正确性之间的不匹配。

articles.title: Echoes of Deeds: Moral History Can Shape and Steer LLM Behavioral Choices
articles.abstract: Evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) morality typically consider decisions in isolation, thus overlooking whether an individual's unrelated prior conduct influences the model's subsequent choices. This leaves open the question of whether, and to what extent, moral history shapes LLM decisional behaviors. Prior work on human moral decision-making shows that past behavior can influence subsequent moral choices. Building on this observation, we investigate whether analogous effects emerge in LLMs in two complementary ways: at the behavioral level, through the model's observable responses, and at the representation level, through its latent internal representations. We introduce MoralLedger, a framework for studying how an actor's moral history shapes actions for LLMs' behaviors under a fixed decision context. At the behavioral level, we find that prior moral histories systematically alter subsequent choices as a function of their valence and intensity. At the internal representation level, these histories induce a linearly recoverable direction in the residual stream that generalizes to held-out examples. Intervening along this direction on neutral-history prompts produces two-sided intensity-dependent changes in subsequent choices, with effects that are stronger than those induced by prompting alone or by favorable-nonmoral direction. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a latent representation of an actor's prior moral conduct can provide signed inference-time control over a moral decision. Our MoralLedger extends moral evaluation beyond static dilemmas, establishing moral history as both a source of behavioral sensitivity and a causal target for auditing and controlling moral behavior in LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 行为回响：道德史可塑造和引导大型语言模型的行为选择
articles.abstractCn: 对大型语言模型（LLMs）道德性的评估通常孤立地考虑决策，从而忽略了个体先前无关行为是否会影响模型的后续选择。这留下了道德历史是否以及程度如何塑造LLM决策行为的问题。先前关于人类道德决策的研究表明，过去的行为会影响后续的道德选择。基于这一观察，我们通过两种互补的方式研究LLMs中是否存在类似效应：在行为层面，通过模型的可观察响应；在表示层面，通过其潜在内部表示。我们引入了MoralLedger框架，用于研究在固定决策情境下，行为者的道德历史如何塑造LLMs的行为。在行为层面，我们发现先前的道德历史系统地改变了后续选择，这取决于其效价和强度。在内部表示层面，这些历史在残差流中诱导了一个可线性恢复的方向，该方向可以推广到未见过的示例。在中等历史提示上沿此方向进行干预，会在后续选择中产生双向强度依赖的变化，其效果强于单独提示或有利非道德方向诱导的效果。据我们所知，这是首次证明行为者的先前道德行为的潜在表示可以提供带符号的推理时控制权，从而影响道德决策。我们的MoralLedger将道德评估扩展到静态困境之外，将道德历史确立为行为敏感性的来源，以及审计和控制LLMs道德行为的因果目标。

articles.title: VEX-Bench: Benchmarking Verification Complexity of LLM-Generated Misinformation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made misinformation inexpensive to produce but not to verify, creating a growing asymmetry in the information ecosystem. Under tight time, labor, and budget constraints, media organizations, platforms, and fact-checkers rely on screening to prioritize which content to verify. We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods. Verification complexity is assessed along multiple dimensions derived from journalistic and fact-checking practices, capturing checkability, harm potential, source credibility signals, imposter legitimacy, and expected verification effort. We define the VEX score as an integrated measure combining elicitation yield and verification complexity to quantify how generated content consumes limited verification capacity. We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles. We employ an LLM-as-judge for scalable evaluation and validate it using content-analysis methodology, including ordinal Krippendorff $α$ for inter-annotator reliability, complemented by fact-checking agents for verification. Our findings show that no single method dominates all dimensions, underscoring the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. LLMs can generate high-VEX misinformation at 3$\times$ to 169$\times$ lower cost than agent-based verification. Such content is often prioritized during screening, consuming scarce verification resources and introducing a systematic risk of misallocation in resource-constrained verification systems. The code is publicly available in our \href{https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench}{GitHub repository}.
articles.titleCn: VEX-Bench：评估LLM生成虚假信息的验证复杂度
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）使得虚假信息的生成变得廉价，但验证成本高昂，从而在信息生态系统中造成了日益增长的不对称性。在严格的时间、劳动力和预算限制下，媒体机构、平台和事实核查者依赖筛选机制来优先确定哪些内容需要验证。我们介绍了VEX-Bench，一个用于评估LLM生成虚假信息验证复杂性的统一基准，该复杂性在筛选过程中被感知，涵盖不同模型和生成方法。验证复杂性从新闻和事实核查实践中推导出多个维度进行评估，捕捉可核查性、潜在危害、来源可信度信号、冒充者合法性以及预期的验证工作量。我们将VEX分数定义为结合启发式产出和验证复杂性的综合指标，以量化生成内容如何消耗有限的验证能力。我们构建了一个涵盖两类虚假信息、六个高风险领域和60个现实主题的基准，评估了7个前沿LLM和7种生成方法，共生成5880篇文章。我们采用“LLM作为法官”进行可扩展评估，并使用内容分析方法进行验证，包括使用顺序Krippendorff α评估标注者间可靠性，并辅以事实核查代理进行验证。我们的研究结果表明，没有单一方法能在所有维度上占据主导地位，突显了多维度评估的必要性。LLMs生成高VEX虚假信息的成本比基于代理的验证低3倍至169倍。此类内容在筛选过程中往往被优先处理，消耗稀缺的验证资源，并在资源受限的验证系统中引入资源分配系统风险。代码已公开托管在我们的GitHub仓库：https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench。

articles.title: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
articles.abstract: We present WebPageBench, an open framework for evaluating web agents in which every task is verified from the interface's own event log. Six instrumented mock sites with brand identifiers removed (a marketplace, a bookstore, a grocery service, rail ticketing, hotel search and a document cabinet) emit typed events with parameters as a user or an agent acts. A task declares the events it requires, and success is decided by matching them, with no judge model and no scraping of rendered pages. The same instrumentation supports controlled UI variation: one configuration switch re-renders a task through a different implementation of a single control while the prompt and the success conditions stay completely identical, so sensitivity to interface form can be measured under a fixed task specification. The WebPageBench release consists of three components: 152 tasks, divided into 65 canonical scenarios and 87 control variants across light/dark UI-modes; a common runner evaluated with six browser/DOM harness configurations and five screenshot-only GUI-agent families; and a public leaderboard of 24 model-harness pairs. On the public 152-task leaderboard the gap between what agents declare finished and what the log confirms reaches 41 points (one configuration declares every task finished and satisfies the conditions on 59%).
articles.titleCn: WebPageBench：针对网络代理的事件级验证与可控界面变体生成
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了WebPageBench，这是一个用于评估网络代理的开源框架，其中每个任务都通过界面自身的日志进行验证。该框架包含六个经过改造的模拟网站（去除品牌标识，包括一个电商平台、书店、杂货服务、火车票务、酒店搜索和文件柜），这些网站会根据用户或代理的行为发出带参数的典型事件。任务会声明所需的事件，并通过匹配这些事件来判定成功，无需裁判模型，也不需要抓取渲染后的页面。相同的改造支持受控的界面变化：通过一个配置开关，使用单个控件的另一种实现重新渲染任务，同时保持提示和成功条件完全一致，从而在固定的任务规范下测量对界面形式的敏感性。WebPageBench发布版包含三个组件：152个任务，分为65个标准场景和87个控制变体（涵盖浅色/深色界面模式）；一个通用执行器，使用六种浏览器/DOM框架配置和五种仅依赖截图的GUI代理系列进行评估；以及一个包含24对模型框架的公共排行榜。在公共152任务排行榜上，代理声明的完成情况与日志确认的完成情况之间的差距达到41分（一种配置将所有任务标记为完成，并在59%的情况下满足条件）。

articles.title: The Right Lesson at the Right Step: Deriving Control Updates for Self-Evolving Agents
articles.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve future behavior by reusing past experience, typically as global prompts, memories, or reflections. Yet these mechanisms rarely control where experience takes effect. In long tool-use workflows, the same lesson may correct one decision but distract another, making experience reuse a problem of localized control rather than memory alone. We introduce EvoCUE (Evolution through Control Updates from Evidence), a framework for learning reusable control-program updates from completed agent executions. EvoCUE represents the agent as an explicit state-machine controller, whose nodes perform model or tool calls and whose edges define where control passes next. This makes the workflow editable at precise locations, so each learned update can specify what to add, where it acts, and when it applies. From completed trajectories, EvoCUE uses residual goals and observed execution traces to propose localized instruction or skill edits. Each candidate is evaluated at the point where it would act by resuming the parent and edited controllers from the same checkpoint and comparing their final outcomes. Accepted edits are compiled with applicability rules, confirmed on held-out tasks, and inherited by later executions. We evaluate EvoCUE on long tool-use environments where learned conventions must reach the right execution step. From a minimal AppWorld controller without benchmark-specific onboarding instructions, EvoCUE learns the missing task-completion convention and substantially improves success on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. On PAST-Bench office workflows, EvoCUE transfers organizational requirements from prior episodes to later tasks, improving task-execution quality. These results show that self-evolving agents should place experience inside the control flow, rather than only store it as text.
articles.titleCn: 在正确的阶段学习正确的课程：为自进化智能体推导控制更新
articles.abstractCn: 自进化智能体通过重用过去的经验来改进未来的行为，通常表现为全局提示、记忆或反思。然而，这些机制很少能控制经验生效的位置。在长工具使用工作流程中，同一个经验教训可能修正一个决策，却干扰另一个决策，使得经验重用成为一个局部控制问题，而不仅仅是记忆本身。我们引入了EvoCUE（通过证据控制更新进行进化），这是一个从完成的智能体执行中学习可重用控制程序更新的框架。EvoCUE将智能体表示为一个显式的状态机控制器，其中节点执行模型或工具调用，而边定义控制传递的下一点位置。这使得工作流程可以在精确位置进行编辑，因此每个学习到的更新可以指定要添加的内容、作用位置以及应用时机。从完成的轨迹中，EvoCUE利用残差目标和观察到的执行轨迹来提出局部指令或技能编辑。每个候选方案都在其将生效的位置进行评估，通过从同一检查点恢复父控制器和编辑后的控制器，并比较它们的最终结果。接受的编辑会与适用规则相结合，在保留的任务上进行确认，并由后续执行继承。我们在需要学习到的规范到达正确执行步骤的长工具使用环境中评估了EvoCUE。从一个没有特定基准在岗培训指令的最小AppWorld控制器开始，EvoCUE学习了缺失的任务完成规范，并在Test-Normal和Test-Challenge上显著提高了成功率。在PAST-Bench办公工作流程中，EvoCUE将先前的情节中的组织要求转移到后续任务，提高了任务执行质量。这些结果表明，自进化智能体应该将经验置于控制流程中，而不仅仅是将其作为文本存储。

articles.title: Nürnberg NLP at ChildSafeAds 2026: Structurally Dissimilar Voter Ensembles under Four Levels of Data Access
articles.abstract: We describe the Nürnberg NLP system for ChildSafeAds 2026. The shared task asks what a monitoring system for commercial content in child-facing YouTube videos can achieve at a given level of data access. We answer with per-subtask ensembles of nine voters, organised into three branches that differ in backbone, adaptation method and class scope. Selection rests on channel-disjoint cross-validation, with the development set as a transfer check. The system wins two of the three subtasks. Its product-category score (ST2, 0.8243) and its compliance-flag score (ST3, 0.6530) are the best of the 22 final entries, and it places third on the task mean (0.7079). We further compare four access levels and report the cost at test-set scale.
articles.comment: Accepted at the ChildSafeAds 2026 Shared Task @ NLLP Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (1st place in 2 of 3 subtasks)
articles.titleCn: 纽伦堡NLP在ChildSafeAds 2026：四种数据访问级别下的结构异质选民集成
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了为ChildSafeAds 2026任务开发的Nuremberg NLP系统。该共享任务要求评估在特定数据访问级别下，用于监控儿童面向YouTube视频商业内容的监控系统所能达到的效果。我们通过九个投票者的每个子任务的集成来回答这一问题，这些投票者被组织成三个分支，它们在主干网络、适应方法和类别范围上有所不同。选择过程基于频道互斥交叉验证，开发集作为迁移检查。该系统在三个子任务中的两个中获胜。其产品类别得分（ST2，0.8243）和合规标志得分（ST3，0.6530）在22个最终提交中表现最佳，并在任务平均得分（0.7079）中位列第三。我们进一步比较了四种访问级别，并报告了在测试集规模下的成本。

articles.title: ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients
articles.abstract: Multi-reward policy optimization requires a joint update that reflects both the learning signals and the intended relationships among objectives. We introduce Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG), which constructs a separate clipped policy objective for each reward and reconciles the resulting gradients into one policy update. For compatible gradients, a cosine-dependent interpolation coordinates their contributions through a partially normalized reference while preserving the norm of their sum. We characterize this update as the unique solution of a spherical directional compromise. For conflicting gradients, projection follows the task's priorities. We evaluate the same compatible rule in helpfulness--safety alignment and correctness--cost optimization for mathematical reasoning. ORPG substantially improves average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest external baseline on each axis. In mathematics, it achieves the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume among the compared methods, with more accurate and shorter responses than the initial policy. Component comparisons and training dynamics show the larger contribution of compatible coordination and a complementary benefit from conflict handling. These results support gradient reconciliation for objectives with equal standing and for objectives with an explicit priority.
articles.titleCn: 基于目标的策略梯度：通过目标策略梯度协调多重奖励目标
articles.abstractCn: 多奖励策略优化需要联合更新，以反映学习信号和目标间预期关系。我们引入了目标协调策略梯度（ORPG），为每个奖励构建独立的裁剪策略目标，并将生成的梯度整合为一个策略更新。对于兼容的梯度，采用余弦依赖插值通过部分归一化参考协调其贡献，同时保持其和的范数。我们将此更新描述为球形方向妥协的唯一解。对于冲突的梯度，投影遵循任务的优先级。我们在数学推理的有用性-安全性对齐和正确性-成本优化中评估了相同的兼容规则。ORPG在各个轴上显著提高了平均有用和无害分数，超越了最强的外部基线。在数学领域，它实现了最高平均全预算准确率和三预算超体积，且响应比初始策略更准确、更短。组件比较和训练动态显示兼容协调贡献更大，冲突处理带来补充收益。这些结果支持梯度协调用于地位平等的目标，以及具有明确优先级的目标。

articles.title: See it, Say it, Sorted: Mechanistic Diagnosis and Parameter-Space Mitigation of Emergent Misalignment in LLMs
articles.abstract: Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens. Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0%; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B--20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety: the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero. Code: https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment.
articles.titleCn: 看见它，说出它，解决它：对大型语言模型中涌现错位现象的机制诊断和参数空间缓解
articles.abstractCn: 安全对齐的大型语言模型可能表现出涌现性错位（EM）：狭窄领域的自适应意外地触发无关领域中的灾难性安全失效。先前的静态分析未能映射训练动态，而现有的防御方法依赖于降低效用的启发式方法。我们提出了一种对EM进行动态、二阶几何研究。通过追踪训练轨迹，我们发现方向性Hessian曲率在语义枢轴标记上高度集中。格拉斯曼投影表明，在大多数情况下，有害-安全差距扩大主要是因为安全梯度重叠度下降。利用这些见解，我们引入了一种参数级几何缓解框架，将经验有害梯度子空间正交投影出参数更新。在Qwen2.5-14B-IT上，我们的防御方法将自由生成的EM抑制了高达80.0%；在其他三个四分之一开放权重指令型模型家族（3B--20B）中，其中单层行为EM已接近零，教师强制评估显示相同的有害子空间控制了冻结EM响应的条件支持。关键在于，这些诊断揭示了行为安全的错觉：在行为EM接近零的模型中，相同的子空间仍然可测量且可控。代码：https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment。

articles.title: Semantic Uncertainty Quantification Needs Factual Equivalence
articles.abstract: Semantic uncertainty quantification for large language models rests on a common template: sample several answers, measure how much they agree, and treat disagreement as uncertainty. We first formalize this template as two separate roles: an operator that compares two answers, and an aggregator that combines all pairwise comparisons into a scalar. Existing methods differ almost entirely in how they aggregate, while taking the operator off the shelf, typically an NLI model or a generic sentence encoder. We show that this reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ: they do not accurately measure factual equivalence of multiple answers to the same question. We resolve this with a deliberately simple recipe: a single encoder trained contrastively to isolate the targeted fact, utilizing synthetic data generated by an LLM and dataset both disjoint from all evaluation settings. Integrating the resulting operator into existing methods improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model dataset combinations across language and vision-language models. The best variant reaches 0.76 mean AUROC against 0.68 for the strongest baseline, while replacing the quadratic cross-encoder comparisons of entailment-based operators with one encoder pass per answer. The uniformity of the improvement supports the view that the operator, not the aggregator, is the limiting factor. The same operator also improves single generation token-level estimators: the norm it assigns to each token measures how much that token bears on the answer, and reweighting token log-likelihoods accordingly sharpens the estimate.
articles.titleCn: 语义不确定性量化需要事实等价
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的语义不确定性量化基于一个通用模板：生成多个答案，测量它们的一致程度，并将不一致视为不确定性。我们首先将此模板形式化为两个独立角色：一个比较两个答案的操作符，以及一个将所有成对比较合并为一个标量的聚合器。现有方法几乎完全在聚合方式上有所不同，而操作符则采用现成的，通常是NLI模型或通用句子编码器。我们表明这种对现成操作符的依赖是语义UQ的主要瓶颈：它们无法准确测量同一问题的多个答案之间的事实等价性。我们通过一个刻意简单的方案解决了这个问题：一个编码器通过对比学习来隔离目标事实，利用由LLM生成的合成数据，该数据集与所有评估设置都互不相交。将得到的操作符集成到现有方法中，在126个评估设置中的120个（95%）上提高了性能，这些设置涵盖了18种语言和视觉语言模型的模型数据集组合。最佳变体达到了0.76的平均AUROC，而最强的基线仅为0.68，同时用单个编码器传递替换了基于蕴涵的操作符的二次交叉编码器比较。改进的统一性支持这样一种观点，即操作符而非聚合器是限制因素。相同的操作符也改进了单次生成的标记级估计器：它为每个标记分配的范数衡量了该标记对答案的相关程度，相应地重新加权标记对数似然度可以锐化估计。

articles.title: Neural Language Models Learn the Contextual Distributions of Dependency Structures: a statistical learning theory to compositionality
articles.abstract: It is unclear how Neural Language Models (NLMs) acquire the structural meaning encoded by grammatical structures that is independent of lexical semantics. We propose a statistical learning process in which learned dependency structures themselves become new distributional units for subsequent statistical learning. Under this account, once a dependency structure is acquired, the model tracks its contextual distributions. These contextual features reflect the semantic properties of a composite structure. To test this hypothesis, we design a synthetic grammar in which each grammatical structure has distinct contextual distributions that cannot be recovered from the distributional statistics of their component tokens alone. We train a series of BERT-style masked language models on this grammar and examine their developmental trajectory. The results show that models can successfully learn the contextual distributions of composite dependency structures even though they cannot be inferred from token statistics alone. Developmental analysis further reveals a clear developmental trajectory. The learning of the dependency relations that define a grammatical structure consistently precedes the learning of its contextual features. These findings suggest that statistical learning in NLMs is not merely the accumulation of token co-occurrence statistics, but a process in which learned dependency structures become new units of distributional learning. We argue that this process provides a statistical-learning account of how NLMs solve the compositionality problem in language. Finally, we discuss the possibility that this statistical learning process provides an explanatory theory on how language cognition could emerge from pure distributional statistics.
articles.titleCn: 神经语言模型学习依存结构的上下文分布：一种关于组合性的统计学习理论
articles.abstractCn: 神经语言模型（NLMs）如何习得由语法结构编码的、独立于词汇语义的结构意义尚不明确。我们提出一个统计学习过程，其中学习到的依存结构本身成为后续统计学习的新分布单元。在此框架下，一旦依存结构被习得，模型就会追踪其上下文分布。这些上下文特征反映了复合结构的语义属性。为验证这一假设，我们设计了一种合成语法，其中每种语法结构具有独特的上下文分布，这些分布无法仅从其组成部分标记的分布统计中恢复。我们在该语法上训练了一系列BERT风格的掩码语言模型，并考察了它们的发展轨迹。结果表明，尽管这些复合依存结构无法从标记统计中推断，模型仍能成功学习其上下文分布。发展分析进一步揭示了一条清晰的发展轨迹：定义语法结构的依存关系的学习始终先于其上下文特征的学习。这些发现表明，NLMs中的统计学习并非仅仅是标记共现统计的累积，而是一个学习到的依存结构成为分布学习新单元的过程。我们认为，这一过程为NLMs如何解决语言的组合性问题提供了统计学习解释。最后，我们讨论了这一统计学习过程可能为语言认知如何从纯粹的分布统计中产生提供解释性理论的可能性。

articles.title: Don't Forget! Decomposing the Training Dynamics of Memorization in Language Models
articles.abstract: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.
articles.titleCn: 别忘了！分解语言模型中记忆训练的动态过程
articles.abstractCn: 记忆化被提出作为一种机制来解释语言模型如何拟合其训练分布的尾部，但其训练动态尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们通过分解记忆序列在训练过程中的损失轨迹和模型参数，对记忆化进行了细粒度分析。在Pythia系列中，我们研究了重复训练序列（背诵）和稀有序列（回忆）的记忆化。我们发现，这两种情况下的记忆化都表现为序列级别的梯度对齐，但背诵会因与其他训练影响的不匹配而造成遗忘，解释了这些示例需要更高重复性的必要性。我们进一步表明，较低模型层最涉及记忆化和遗忘。在预测记忆化的过程中，我们的分解方法优于交叉熵基线，尤其是在较大的模型和训练早期。通过干预一小部分高度有影响力的参数，我们能够在最终模型中消除记忆化。这些发现共同加深了我们对训练过程中记忆化如何发展的理解，并为预测和干预记忆化提供了见解。

articles.title: Sample What You Say: Aligning Language Models to Sample the Distributions They State
articles.abstract: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group's empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model's distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout's advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group's outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.
articles.titleCn: 根据您所说进行采样：将语言模型与其所述的分布进行对齐
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地用于从指定分布中进行采样，例如模拟调查受访者或生成合成数据。指令微调的模型能够正确声明这种分布，但仍然无法从中采样。提示和解码变化只能部分减少这种不匹配，这促使我们采用策略优化进行训练。组相对策略优化（GRPO）非常适合这个问题，因为它已经为每个提示采样一组 rollout，并且可以比较组的经验分布与目标分布。然而，将整个组作为一个整体进行评分会给每个 rollout 相同的奖励。组相对中心化随后将所有优势值设为零，模型因此无法获得学习信号。为了给每个 rollout 提供独立的信号，我们引入了证人优势，这是一种基于最大均值差异（MMD）的每 rollout 优势。它训练模型去匹配有限结果集上的目标分布。模型分布与目标分布之间的 MMD 具有一个证人函数，用于测量每个结果的过度或不足生产程度。每个 rollout 的优势值估计其在结果处的负证人值，因此 rollout 会因组中不足生产的结果而获得奖励，因过度生产的结果而受到惩罚。证人优势值通过组的成果计数以封闭形式计算，我们将其用作 GRPO 中的奖励。在未见过的目标分布上，使用证人优势进行训练能显著降低与目标的总体变差距离，同时基本保持模型的一般能力。

articles.title: Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change
articles.abstract: A voice agent can handle almost every call on the words alone and still fail the few its sector's rules were written for. Emergency-call standards, fraud guidance, radio phraseology and vulnerability rules recognise that how a caller sounds, or what else is audible, can change the right action. VoxParity tests whether agents act on it. In 183 scenarios from 14 sectors, one transcript stays fixed while the audio changes (a coaching voice, a medical monitor beeping, a mayday under a radio check, noise over a drug name, a child's voice placing a bet, a frightened whisper), and with it the correct typed tool call. A words-only null test credits a system only if hearing the call moves its actions more than it moves a pipeline that only reads the words. Only 11 of the 23 systems that can also be run on the transcript pass. Descriptively, errors run toward the words: when the audio calls for protection, all 28 systems carry out the routine request more often than they over-react on clean calls (41% against 12% pooled; the words-only pipeline, 58% against 15%). Exploratory analyses place most of the leading systems' misses on cues they heard; systems beat the null almost entirely on items that state the rule; the leading systems overrule heard resignation or confusion far more often than acute alarm; and, in the models tested, describing the voice and stating the rule each recover part of the shortfall, leaving a gap on emotion.
articles.comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Code, scorer and development-split data at https://github.com/bhavik-mangla/voxparity-bench and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23008159
articles.titleCn: 几乎像人类，但当重要的事情发生时：VoxParity和声音应该改变的决定
articles.abstractCn: 一个语音代理几乎可以凭借语音处理所有来电，但仍会因其所属领域的规则而失败少数情况。紧急呼叫标准、欺诈指南、无线电短语和脆弱性规则都认识到，来电者的声音或可听到的其他内容可能会改变正确的行动。VoxParity测试代理是否会根据这些因素采取行动。在14个领域的183个场景中，一个文本记录保持固定，而音频内容会变化（教练声音、医疗监控器的哔哔声、无线电检查下的求救信号、药品名称上的噪音、孩子下注的声音、受惊的耳语），以及相应的正确输入工具调用。一个仅依赖文本的空测试只有在听到呼叫能比仅读取文本的管道更能改变其行动时，才会认可该系统。在23个系统中有11个也能运行在文本上的系统通过测试。描述性分析显示错误倾向于文本：当音频要求保护时，所有28个系统执行常规请求的频率高于对干净呼叫的过度反应（41%对12%，合并数据；仅依赖文本的管道为58%对15%）。探索性分析将领先系统的大多数失误归因于他们听到的线索；系统几乎完全依靠陈述规则的项目来超越空测试；领先系统在处理听到的沮丧或困惑时，远比处理紧急警报更频繁地推翻；在测试的模型中，描述声音和陈述规则分别弥补了部分差距，但在情感方面仍存在空白。

articles.title: ColNanoVDR: Document-Free Query Distillation for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval via Optimal Transport
articles.abstract: Multi-vector retrievers built on vision-language models lead visual document retrieval (VDR), but they run a multi-billion-parameter query encoder on every search. Distilling this encoder into a small student that queries the teacher's existing index would remove the bottleneck. The standard recipe, however, matches the teacher's MaxSim scores and so requires encoding and caching every training page, which can reach terabytes of page tokens. NanoVDR avoids pages entirely by training on the teacher's query embeddings alone, but only for single-vector retrievers. We present ColNanoVDR, to our knowledge the first framework to bring this document-free distillation to multi-vector VDR. Its objective, OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights), aligns the student's query tokens with the teacher's by entropic optimal transport, with a learned weight for each student token, and needs no correspondence between the two tokenizations. We prove that the resulting alignment cost bounds the MaxSim score difference on every page. Distilled from five state-of-the-art teachers, the 149M text-only students retain about 95% of their teachers' NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1-v3 while encoding queries up to 26x faster. Under identical training, OTW matches score distillation while encoding no page and reading 12.6x less cached teacher data.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR ; Models: https://huggingface.co/nanovdr
articles.titleCn: ColNanoVDR：基于最优传输的多向量视觉文档无文档查询蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 基于视觉-语言模型的多元向量检索器推动了视觉文档检索（VDR）的发展，但它们在每次搜索时都会运行一个拥有数十亿参数的查询编码器。将这个编码器蒸馏成一个小的学生模型，使其查询教师现有的索引，可以消除瓶颈。然而，标准方法需要匹配教师的MaxSim分数，因此需要编码和缓存每个训练页面，这可能导致页面令牌达到TB级别。NanoVDR完全避免了页面，仅通过训练教师查询嵌入来训练，但仅适用于单向量检索器。我们提出了ColNanoVDR，据我们所知，这是首个将无文档蒸馏应用于多元向量VDR的框架。其目标函数OTW（带学习权重的最优传输）通过熵最优传输将学生的查询令牌与教师的令牌对齐，每个学生令牌都有一个学习的权重，且不需要两种令牌化之间的对应关系。我们证明，由此产生的对齐成本可以限制每页上的MaxSim分数差异。从五个最先进的教师模型蒸馏出的1.49亿文本学生模型，在ViDoRe v1-v3上保留了约95%的教师NDCG@5，同时查询编码速度提高了26倍。在相同的训练条件下，OTW在无需编码页面且缓存教师数据读取量减少12.6倍的情况下，实现了与分数蒸馏相同的效果。

articles.title: One Readout, Many Repairs: Diffusion-Guided Hierarchical Search for Tool-Agent Repair
articles.abstract: Tool agents use large language models to act through external tools, yet successfully executed calls can still leave user requests unfulfilled. Tool-agent repair seeks alternative call sequences that execute successfully and fulfill the original requests. However, repair requires exploring both operation choices and their concrete realizations, making complete-sequence regeneration costly. Moreover, regeneration repeats operation selection even when failure arises from how those operations are realized. The resulting challenge is to reduce this repetition while preserving exploration of alternative operations and realizations. Therefore, we formulate repair as hierarchical search over operation supports, which we introduce as sets of permitted operation types that define reusable search regions for concrete tool-call sequences. We propose ReCommit, a training-free, diffusion-guided framework for improving tool-agent failure recovery while reducing repair computation. ReCommit amortizes operation-level proposal computation across repair trials by reusing operation-type scores from a single parallel readout of a masked diffusion language model. These scores guide search across supports, while realization search explores alternative entity bindings, arguments, and action composition within each support. Experiments on real failures across four enterprise services in the Agent-Diff benchmark show 75.9\% and 63.2\% relative recovery gains with 61.3\% and 51.3\% reductions in mean full-budget repair time at repair budgets $B=3$ and $B=13$, respectively, over the strongest evaluated 8B comparison method. ReCommit achieves a favorable recovery--cost trade-off, including in comparisons with the evaluated 32B models.
articles.titleCn: 一个读数，多次维修：基于扩散引导的层次搜索工具代理维修
articles.abstractCn: 工具代理使用大型语言模型通过外部工具执行操作，但成功执行的调用仍可能无法满足用户请求。工具代理修复旨在寻找替代的调用序列，以成功执行并满足原始请求。然而，修复需要探索操作选择及其具体实现，导致完整序列再生成本高昂。此外，即使失败源于操作实现方式，再生过程仍会重复操作选择。由此产生的挑战是减少这种重复，同时保留对替代操作和实现的探索。因此，我们将修复定义为对操作支持的自顶向下搜索，我们将操作支持引入为定义具体工具调用序列的可重用搜索区域的允许操作类型集合。我们提出了ReCommit，这是一个无需训练、基于扩散引导的框架，用于提高工具代理的失败恢复能力，同时减少修复计算量。ReCommit通过重用单个并行掩码扩散语言模型读取的操作类型分数，将操作级别的提议计算摊销到多次修复尝试中。这些分数指导在支持上的搜索，而实现搜索在每个支持内探索替代实体绑定、参数和动作组合。在Agent-Diff基准中，对四个企业服务的真实失败进行的实验表明，在修复预算B=3和B=13时，与最强的8B比较方法相比，ReCommit实现了75.9%和63.2%的相对恢复增益，以及61.3%和51.3%的平均全预算修复时间减少。ReCommit在恢复与成本之间的权衡方面表现良好，包括在与评估的32B模型比较时。

articles.title: Beyond Verbalized Confidence: Calibrating Reasoners with Differentiable Readouts
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models to produce correct answers, but does not ensure that their stated confidence is calibrated. The resulting models are systematically overconfident. Recent methods train calibration inside the RLVR loop by having the model state a numerical confidence alongside its answer, but they all obtain the confidence by sampling it as text. This choice imposes two costs: a sampled confidence introduces variance and in practice collapses to a handful of distinct values, and sampling makes the confidence non-differentiable, forcing the calibration loss through a scalar reward. We propose CREDO (Confidence REaDOut) to replace sampling with a deterministic readout. While RLVR optimizes correctness, CREDO reads the confidence from a dedicated token pair in the model's output distribution and trains it by differentiable regression. CREDO further turns the trained confidence into a signal for accuracy, weighting rollouts by how far confidence and outcome disagree, so that accuracy and calibration improve together. Across mathematical and code reasoning, CREDO attains the best accuracy and calibration, and the gains extend to abstention and selective prediction.
articles.titleCn: 超越言语化的自信：通过可微读数校准推理器
articles.abstractCn: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练推理模型生成正确答案，但无法确保其声明的置信度经过校准。由此产生的模型系统性地过度自信。最近的方法通过让模型在答案旁边声明一个数值置信度来在RLVR循环内训练校准，但它们都通过文本采样来获得置信度。这种选择带来了两个成本：采样的置信度引入了方差，并且在实践中会缩减为少数几个不同的值，而采样使得置信度不可微，迫使校准损失通过一个标量奖励。我们提出了CREDO（置信度读取输出）来用确定性读取替代采样。虽然RLVR优化正确性，CREDO从模型输出分布中的一个专用标记对中读取置信度，并通过可微分的回归进行训练。CREDO进一步将训练好的置信度转化为准确性的信号，通过置信度和结果不一致的程度对 rollout 进行加权，从而使得准确性和校准共同提高。在数学和代码推理方面，CREDO达到了最佳准确性和校准，并且这种收益扩展到了拒绝回答和选择性预测。

articles.title: Adapt Semantics, Not Structure: Few-Instance Schema Calibration for Scientific PDF Extraction
articles.abstract: A well-designed extraction schema is not necessarily ready for reliable LLM execution. When only limited verified extractions are available, manually tuning hundreds of field definitions through trial and error is costly. We frame this problem as few-instance schema calibration: adapting the operational semantics of an existing schema from a few annotated documents while preserving its structural contract. We introduce CPSE, a contract-preserving semantic extraction framework that jointly calibrates extraction prompts and field-level semantic descriptions from a few gold annotations. CPSE decomposes the schema into an invariant structural contract and mutable field semantics, and further separates identity discovery from record completion using manifest-conditioned resolution. On expert-annotated polymer-science documents, CPSE improves extraction by 9.93 points over an execution-matched baseline, with consistent gains under an independent judge and in a blinded expert audit. These results show that CPSE enables low-resource schema execution while preserving the output structure required downstream.
articles.titleCn: 适应语义，而非结构：科学PDF提取的少实例模式校准
articles.abstractCn: 一个设计良好的提取模式未必适用于可靠的LLM执行。当可用的验证提取有限时，通过反复试验手动调整数百个字段定义成本高昂。我们将此问题定义为少实例模式校准：在保留其结构契约的同时，通过少量标注文档调整现有模式的有效语义。我们引入CPSE，这是一个保留契约的语义提取框架，它从少量黄金标注中联合校准提取提示和字段级语义描述。CPSE将模式分解为不变的结构契约和可变的字段语义，并进一步使用显式条件解析将身份发现与记录补全分离。在专家标注的聚合物科学文档上，CPSE比执行匹配基线提高了9.93分，并在独立评判者和盲法专家审核中始终获得一致提升。这些结果表明CPSE能够在保留下游所需输出结构的同时，实现低资源模式执行。

articles.title: OpenWhistle: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Dataset and Benchmark of Bottlenose Dolphin Vocalizations
articles.abstract: Recent advances in bioacoustics have been driven by large-scale corpora and standardized benchmarks, yet existing resources are overwhelmingly bird-centric and shallow per species, limiting their use for studying the structure of a single species' communication system. This gap is particularly acute for cetaceans: despite bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) being a compelling case of complex vocal communication among non-human mammals, existing dolphin datasets are small, fragmented, and largely closed. We introduce OpenWhistle, the largest publicly available dataset of dolphin vocalizations. It comprises approximately 180,000 whistles (114 hours) recorded over five years from a stable pod of five individuals in a semi-natural environment, paired with a curated subset of 8,354 expert-annotated whistles and reproducible evaluation protocols for whistle-type detection and classification. We further release the full processing pipeline for whistle detection, segmentation, and categorization. To demonstrate its utility, we pretrain a Wav2Vec2.0 model adapted to dolphin acoustics on the OpenWhistle corpus and show that it learns effective representations, outperforming general-purpose bioacoustic models such as AVES and BioLingual on both tasks while leaving meaningful headroom for future work. By releasing the dataset, pipeline, and evaluation protocol, we provide the first open dolphin whistle dataset tailored for training self-supervised models, laying the groundwork for advancing dolphin communication research and developing models that capture fine-grained acoustic structure within species.
articles.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Datasets & Evaluations Track
articles.titleCn: OpenWhistle：一个大规模纵向数据集和海豚发声的基准
articles.abstractCn: 生物声学领域的最新进展得益于大规模语料库和标准化基准，但现有资源过度集中于鸟类且每个物种的信息深度不足，限制了它们在研究单一物种交流系统结构方面的应用。对于鲸类而言，这一差距尤为突出：尽管宽吻海豚（Tursiops truncatus）是非人哺乳动物中复杂发声交流的典型案例，但现有的海豚数据集规模小、零散且大多封闭。我们介绍了OpenWhistle，这是目前最大公开可用的海豚发声数据集。该数据集包含约18万次哨声（114小时）录音，记录于五年内半自然环境中一个由五头稳定个体组成的群体，并配有8,354次专家标注哨声的精选子集以及哨声类型检测和分类的可重复评估协议。我们进一步发布了哨声检测、分割和分类的完整处理流程。为了展示其效用，我们在OpenWhistle语料库上预训练了一个针对海豚声学特性适配的Wav2Vec2.0模型，证明该模型能够学习有效的表征，在两项任务中均优于通用生物声学模型如AVES和BioLingual，并为未来工作留下了充足的空间。通过发布数据集、流程和评估协议，我们提供了首个专为训练自监督模型设计的开放海豚哨声数据集，为推进海豚交流研究、开发能够捕捉物种内部精细声学结构的模型奠定了基础。

articles.title: DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student agents through teacher supervision on their own interactions with an environment. However, in asynchronous multi-turn training, arrival-order batching can allow a few early or long rollouts to dominate learner updates while other valid rollouts become stale before being used, wasting already-generated experience. To address this problem, we introduce DivOPD, a simple learner-side batch-selection method that spreads a fixed turn budget across more rollouts and, within each rollout, prioritizes turns with larger cumulative teacher-student disagreement. Turns without usable teacher feedback are excluded. The per-turn loss and optimizer remain fixed; selection only changes which student-visited turns receive training weight. For no-progress rollouts, an optional extension briefly hands control to the teacher before returning it to the student. Across six teacher-student settings on the simulated ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop benchmarks, with 1.5B-7B students, DivOPD raises cross-setting mean peak success rate from 77.4 to 84.4 and mean success over the last five evaluations from 71.5 to 78.6. It reaches all reported setting-specific targets with geometric-mean speedups of 1.84x in training tokens and 1.87x in learner GPU time relative to vanilla OPD. Teacher intervention further raises this last-five mean to 82.4 while retaining about 1.7x learner-GPU speedup over vanilla OPD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HanyangWang0418-oss/DivOPD.
articles.titleCn: DivOPD：广泛传播，近距离观察，用于多轮智能体的异步在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 基于策略的蒸馏（OPD）通过教师监督训练学生智能体，利用智能体自身与环境的交互。然而，在异步多轮训练中，按到达顺序批处理可能导致少数早期或较长的运行主导学习者的更新，而其他有效的运行在未被使用前就已过时，浪费了已生成的经验。为解决这个问题，我们引入了DivOPD，这是一种简单的学习者端批处理选择方法，将固定的回合预算分配到更多运行中，并在每个运行内部优先考虑具有较大累积教师-学生分歧的回合。不可用的教师反馈回合将被排除。每个回合的损失和优化器保持固定；选择仅改变哪些被学生访问的回合获得训练权重。对于无进展的运行，可选的扩展会在将其控制权交还给学生之前，短暂地将控制权交给教师。在模拟的ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop基准测试的六个教师-学生设置中，学生规模为1.5B-7B，DivOPD将跨设置平均峰值成功率从77.4提高到84.4，并将最后五次评估的平均成功率从71.5提高到78.6。它达到了所有报告的特定设置目标，相对于原版OPD，训练token的几何平均加速比为1.84倍，学习者GPU时间的几何平均加速比为1.87倍。教师干预进一步将最后五次评估的平均成功率提高到82.4，同时保持了相对于原版OPD约1.7倍的学习者-GPU加速比。代码将在https://github.com/HanyangWang0418-oss/DivOPD发布。

articles.title: BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.
articles.titleCn: 块验证感知损失：用于块扩散推测解码的块验证损失
articles.abstractCn: 扩散式草稿员通过并行提出多个标记来加速推测解码。尽管在序列级草稿和验证方面推测解码取得了最近的进展，但现有的训练目标仍然主要围绕标记级验证进行设计。为了解决这种不匹配，我们引入了区块验证感知损失（BV损失），这是一种旨在最大化草稿序列预期接受长度的训练目标。BV损失直接源于区块验证接受规则，为草稿员训练目标与推理时序列级验证机制之间建立了原则性联系。在数学、代码和聊天基准测试中，与交叉熵损失训练相比，BV损失使DFlash和DSpark在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上通过区块验证的每次验证接受的标记平均数量增加了13.0--21.0%，且未改变推理过程。BV损失还优于TV损失和LK损失等标记级接受目标，其收益延伸至标记验证和贪婪解码。这些结果表明，使用与序列级验证一致的训练目标来训练区块扩散草稿员，比独立优化每个标记更有优势。

articles.title: From Weak Task Specifications to Scientific Extraction Agents: Optimizing Task Construction
articles.abstract: Most methods that optimize LLM prompts and agent workflows assume that task-specific output schemas, extraction instructions, and evaluation criteria are predefined. For scientific extraction agents, however, a short task goal may not fully determine these components, while specifying them manually is costly. We study the upstream problem of constructing the task-specific configuration from a weak specification containing only a short goal and unannotated reference documents. Rather than treating automatic construction as a fixed preprocessing step, our framework constructs a task-specific schema, extraction instructions, and base training rubrics, then keeps schema construction and extraction instructions editable during optimization. Failure-focused updates concentrate textual-gradient feedback on lower-scoring documents, while training-time evaluation criteria adapt to recurring failures. On a heterogeneous-catalysis literature corpus, automatic construction remains improvable, and optimizing both schema construction and extraction instructions performs best across all four judge-rubric settings, with ablations and blinded human evaluation supporting the proposed formulation.
articles.titleCn: 从弱任务规范到科学提取代理：优化任务构建
articles.abstractCn: 大多数优化大型语言模型提示和代理工作流的方法都假设任务特定的输出模式、提取指令和评估标准是预先定义的。然而，对于科学提取代理而言，简短的任务目标可能无法完全确定这些组件，而手动指定它们则成本高昂。我们研究从仅包含简短目标和未标注参考文档的弱规范中构建任务特定配置的上游问题。我们的框架并非将自动构建视为固定的预处理步骤，而是构建任务特定的模式、提取指令和基础训练评分标准，然后在优化过程中保持模式构建和提取指令的可编辑性。以失败为导向的更新将文本梯度反馈集中在得分较低的文档上，而训练时的评估标准会根据反复出现的失败进行调整。在一个异质催化文献语料库上，自动构建仍有改进空间，优化模式构建和提取指令在所有四个裁判评分标准设置中表现最佳，消融实验和盲法人工评估支持了所提出的方案。

articles.title: Pass or Fail? Evaluating LLMs on Two Greek Examination Benchmarks
articles.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) imposes a thorough evaluation of their linguistic and analytical capabilities as well as constraints, particularly for a language with limited benchmark coverage such as Greek.
